purpose: Independently calibrate and validate the physical cold-chain contract before any calibrated DEV or formal VAL method evaluation.

authority.source_baseline_audit: ../../决策与审计/O0CC源码字节基线与行尾处置.md

firewall.decision_rule: Physical model, parameters, thresholds, and sensitivity contracts must be selected using source evidence and CAL-PHYS physical outcomes only.
firewall.violation_action: PROTOCOL_ERROR; invalidate the affected fit and create a new protocol version before refitting.

target_contract.fallback_decision_basis: predefined identifiability and physical holdout rules only

research_questions.question: Can a load-dependent lumped thermal model predict closed-door temperature trajectories on held-out independent runs?
Can a duration- and temperature-lift-dependent door model predict temperature excursion and recovery on held-out independent door-event runs?
Can a thermally consistent cooling-capacity/COP model predict held-out electrical energy without treating cooling capacity as electrical input power?
For each preregistered representative product and quality indicator, does the declared kinetic model predict held-out variable-temperature quality trajectories?

experimental_units.thermal_unit: one independently initialized vehicle/compartment run with its own condition assignment
experimental_units.door_unit: one independently initialized door-event run; multiple sensor timestamps within the run are repeated measurements
experimental_units.energy_unit: one independently metered pull-down, steady-state, door-recovery, or route-like run
experimental_units.quality_unit: one independently sourced and handled product lot assigned to a temperature program
experimental_units.technical_replicates: multiple sensors, subsamples, or timestamps inside one independent unit improve measurement precision but do not increase independent n
experimental_units.prohibited_pseudoreplication: timestamps, sensors, and subsamples must never be counted as independent treatment replicates

design.structure: blocked split-plot factorial with an independently held-out route-like validation phase
design.factorial_principle: Estimate prespecified main effects and required two-factor interactions; do not use one-factor-at-a-time data as the sole basis for the final dynamic contract.
design.center_points: Include replicated center-condition runs when safe to test curvature before accepting a linear lift/load relation.

randomization.method: seeded random order within feasible whole-plot blocks
randomization.allocation_concealment: The frozen schedule is generated before outcome collection and cannot be changed without a logged protocol deviation.

controls: closed-door cooling-on pull-down and steady state
quality assay reference/control specified per product

phases.purpose: sensor calibration, clock synchronization, repeatability, and meter cross-check
closed-door cooling-off thermal response across ambient, set-point history, and load
pull-down and steady cooling capacity, input power, COP, and preconditioning energy
door heat, peak excursion, recovery time, and recovery energy across duration and load
quality reaction order and Arrhenius parameters using at least three in-range temperatures per product
one-shot validation on unseen whole thermal runs and unseen whole product lots under route-like variable-temperature programs

partition_policy.split_level: whole independent run for thermal/energy and whole product lot for quality
partition_policy.holdout_lock_time: before fitting or plotting outcome-dependent summaries
partition_policy.holdout_access: single confirmatory evaluation after model and thresholds are frozen

sample_size_policy.independent_n_unit: independent run or independent product lot
sample_size_policy.pilot_use: estimate variance, within-unit correlation, sensor noise, and feasible ranges only
sample_size_policy.pilot_variance_rule: The P1 analysis plan must freeze a conservative variance rule before pilot outcome access (for example, a prespecified upper confidence bound or worst supported stratum), rather than plugging an unstable point estimate into the final n calculation.
sample_size_policy.planning_criterion: Choose the maximum independent-unit requirement across all primary response families, include block/cluster structure and a prespecified allowance for non-outcome-based run loss, and document simulation or analytical inputs. Routing-method effects may not enter this calculation.
sample_size_policy.final_rule: Freeze minimum and target independent-unit counts per design cell after the documented precision/power calculation; technical replicate counts cannot substitute for independent units and realized counts below the frozen minimum return DATA_INSUFFICIENT.

pilot_registration.purpose: estimate instrument repeatability, clock error, feasible measurement ranges, run-level variance, and within-run correlation for final design and precision planning
pilot_registration.rule: status may change from draft_blocked to pilot_registered only after source byte closure, object/instrument registration, a restricted P1 schedule, raw-data identity rules, and pilot analysis rules are sealed

stopping_policy.optional_safety_stop: stop only for preregistered equipment, food-safety, or operator-safety limits
stopping_policy.optional_data_quality_stop: pause collection for verified instrument or protocol failure; preserve all acquired raw data and deviations
stopping_policy.success_stop: complete the frozen schedule; do not stop early because a physical fit or later routing method appears favorable

freeze_rule: pilot_registered permits P1-INSTRUMENT only and never permits final parameter fitting; status may change to frozen for P2-P6 only when blocking_fields is empty, JSON/CSV validation passes, the source byte baseline is sealed, and the freeze checklist is signed; after these files are final, a separate non-self-referential CAL_PHYS_PROTOCOL_FREEZE_SEAL.json records every file hash and the bundle hash.
